text: OWNER ACCEPTANCE UPDATE 2026-08-31: the repaired /scala/getting-started/ is better and now runs a real public comparison, prints exact output, and draws one mass figure, but the owner still finds it extremely thin for the size of the library. This is a site-level requirement, not another single-page wording patch: the guide must show what the library does through executable code, explanation, exact archived output, and static plots/diagrams. Proposed successor bar, pending chief routing: a visible capability tour across source atlas/evidence; proposition and story/context modeling; recall graph; feature and embedding sidecars with receipts; partial GraphHsmm alignment retaining posterior P, transition flow F, external states and Viterbi summary; support-aware RecallSignature; Autobiographical Interview scoring; acquisition partial/refused outcomes; and canonical output bundles/codecs. Each workflow should expose 8-15 lines of public API, 3-6 exact output lines, one plain-language interpretation, and a link to a full worked page; figures need textual twins. Preserve the honest boundary that arbitrary-prose-to-complete-model is not yet delivered.
